toast_invalid_date_format_full: Ifomati yomhla engasebenziyo. Khetha umhla opheleleyo.
auth_sign_in_subtitle: Fikelela kwindawo yakho yokusebenza esibhedlele ngokukhuselekileyo.
auth_welcome_back_body: Sayina ungene ukuze ulawule izigulana, uluhlu lwempahla, ukuqeshwa, kunye nokuqhutywa komsebenzi weklinikhi kwiqela lakho.
auth_welcome_signup_body: Yenza i-akhawunti yokulawula izigulana, uluhlu, ukuqeshwa, kunye nokuhamba komsebenzi weklinikhi kwiqela lakho.
auth_forgot_subtitle: Ngenisa i-imeyile kwiakhawunti yakho. Siza kuthumela ikhonkco lokusetha kwakhona ukuba lihambelana nomsebenzisi obhalisiweyo.
auth_check_email_body: Ukuba i-{email} ibhalisiwe, ikhonkco lokusetha kwakhona lisendleleni. Ikhonkco liphelelwa kwimizuzu eyi-15.
auth_set_password_hint: Ubuncinci amagama asi-8 anenani kunye nesimboli.
auth_otp_subtitle: Sithumele ikhowudi yeedijithi ezi-6 kwi-{email}. Iphelelwa kwimizuzu eyi-10.
auth_2fa_subtitle: Faka ikhowudi enamanani ama-6 ukusuka kwi-app yakho ye-athenticator.
auth_2fa_setup_subtitle: Qinisekisa igama lokugqitha lakho ukuze wenze ikhowudi yeQR yesiqinisekiso.
auth_2fa_setup_scan_subtitle: Skena nge-app yakho yesiqinisekiso, emva koko ufake ikhowudi enamanani ama-6.
auth_2fa_backup_codes_subtitle: Gcina ezi khowudi kwindawo ekhuselekileyo. Ikhowudi nganye ingasetyenziswa kube kanye.
auth_2fa_account_disable_hint: Ngenisa igama lokugqitha lakho ukuze ucime uqinisekiso lwezinto ezimbini.
auth_2fa_account_change_hint: Faka enye indawo yesiqinisekisi sakho. Usetyenziso olukhoyo luya kuyeka ukusebenza de uskene i-QR entsha.
auth_2fa_setup_change_subtitle: Qinisekisa igama lokugqitha lakho ukuze ubuyisele ikhowudi yakho yeQR yesiqinisekiso.
auth_2fa_account_backup_regen_hint: Faka igama lokugqithisa lakho. Iikhowudi zogcino lwangaphambili ziya kuyeka ukusebenza.
auth_2fa_account_backup_regen_success: Iikhowudi ezintsha zogcino zilungile. Zigcine kwindawo ekhuselekileyo.
session_extend_description: Qinisekisa igama lokugqitha lakho ukongeza iiyure ezi-2 ngaphezulu kule seshini.
session_extend_password_hint: Ngenisa igama lokugqithisa leakhawunti ongene ngayo. Ungandisa kube kanye ngeseshoni.
auth_2fa_account_multi_device_hint: Ngexesha lokuseta ungaskena i-QR enye ngesixhobo esingaphezulu kwesinye.
auth_2fa_required_for_action: Ukuqinisekiswa kwezinto ezimbini kuyafuneka kwesi senzo. Yimise ukuze uqhubeke.
set_new_password_description: Seta igama lokugqitha elitsha kwiakhawunti yakho.
enter_email_reset_description: Ngenisa i-imeyile yakho kwaye siza kukuthumelela ilinki yokuseta kwakhona igama lakho eliyimfihlo.
invalid_reset_link: Ilinki yokuseta ngokutsha engasebenziyo okanye ephelelwe lixesha. Nceda ucele entsha ngezantsi.
password_min_length: Igama lokugqithisa kufuneka libe noonobumba abasi-8 ubuncinane.
reset_email_sent: Ukuba kukho i-akhawunti yale imeyile, ikhonkco lokusetha ngokutsha igama lokugqitha lithunyelwe.
password_reset_success: Ukusetha kwakhona igama lokugqithisa ngempumelelo. Ungangena ngoku.
op_billing_discount_locked_after_print: Lo mthetho uyilwayo washicilelwa; isaphulelo sotyelelo-level ayinakuguqulwa.
op_billing_discount_locked_tooltip: Isaphulelo sitshixiwe emva kokuba ityala lishicilelwe.
op_billing_nothing_to_close: Akukho zinkonzo zigqityiweyo ezisalindele ukuhlawulwa kolu tyelelo.
op_billing_no_services_found: Akukho nkonzo zigqityiweyo zilindele ukuhlawulwa kolu tyelelo.
op_billing_readiness_nursing_hint: Gqibezela ukonga kugqityiwe kuzo zonke iintambo zenkonzo phambi kokuba kuvalwe.
ip_billing_discount_locked_after_print: Lo mthetho uyilwayo washicilelwa; isaphulelo sotyelelo-level ayinakuguqulwa.
ip_billing_no_services_found: Akukho nkonzo zihlawulwayo ezifunyenweyo kolu tyelelo.
no_hospital_assigned: Akukho sibhedlele sinikezelwe kwiakhawunti yakho. Qhagamshelana nomlawuli wakho.
no_hospitals_yet: Akukho zibhedlele okwangoku. Yenza enye ukuze uqalise.
owner_no_hospitals_yet: Akukho zibhedlele okwangoku. Qhagamshelana nomlawuli wakho ukuze uqalise.
hospital_coding_system_help: Ibophelela esi sibhedlele kumgangatho omnye wekhowudi yokuxilongwa kwe-WHO. Akunakutshintsha emva kokuba kukho uxilongo olunekhowudi.
hospital_coding_system_locked: Inkqubo yekhowudi itshixiwe kuba esi sibhedlele sele sinekhowudi yoxilongo.
hospital_coding_release_unknown: Akukho khathalogu ye-WHO yokungenisa erekhodiweyo okwangoku.
hospital_coding_release_line: I-{system} ikhupha i-{releaseId} (iikhowudi ze-{count}, i-{importedAt} engeniswe ngaphandle)
icd_who_attribution: Umxholo we-ICD-10 kunye ne-ICD-11 yi-copyright ye-World Health Organization (WHO). I-ICD-11 ilayisenisi phantsi kweCC BY-ND 3.0 IGO. Ukusetyenziswa kufuna ukubalelwa; Ulungelelwaniso lufuna imvume ye-WHO.
docs_coding_standards_body: Isibhedlele ngasinye sibophelela inkqubo yekhowudi yokuxilongwa kwe-WHO (ICD-10 okanye i-ICD-11 MMS) ngexesha lokudala. Uphando lokuxilongwa kwe-EMR lusebenzisa loo khathalogu kuphela. Iikhathalogu ezipheleleyo zingeniswa kumazwe angaphandle nge-WHO ICD-API kwitheyibhile ekwabelwana ngayo.
name: Igama
admin_overview_subtitle: Amanani kunye neendlela ezimfutshane zolawulo lwenkqubo.
admin_no_hospitals_yet: Akukho zibhedlele okwangoku. Yenza enye kwaye ubophe umnini.
admin_team_subtitle: Mema abancedisi kwaye usete ukuba ngawaphi amaphepha olawulo abanokuwasebenzisa.
admin_team_need_view: Ubuncinci iphepha elinye kufuneka libe nemvume yokujonga.
admin_team_invite_hint: Baza kufumana i-imeyile yokusetha kwakhona iphasiwedi ukuseta igama labo lokugqitha.
admin_team_matrix_hint: Ukujonga kuyafuneka phambi kokuba udale, uhlele, okanye ucime kwiphepha.
admin_team_reset_sent: I-imeyile yokusetha kwakhona igama lokugqithisa ithunyelwe.
admin_team_reset_failed: Ayikwazanga ukuthumela igama lokuseta kwakhona i-imeyile.
admin_monitoring_subtitle: Ukusetyenziswa, umsebenzi wamva nje, kunye nempilo yedathabheyisi.
admin_staff_subtitle: Bonke abasebenzisi abanendima yabasebenzi kwizibhedlele zonke.
admin_ops_subtitle: Ukusetyenziswa okuphilayo, umsebenzi wamva nje, kunye nempilo yedathabheyisi.
admin_ops_load_error: Ayikwazanga ukulayisha umsebenzi kunye nedatha yezempilo.
admin_ops_usage_subtitle: Iiseshoni kunye noyilo lwamva nje oluvela kwisiseko sedatha ephilayo.
admin_ops_activity_subtitle: Ukungena kwamva nje kunye nequmrhu liyadala.
admin_ops_db_quota_note: Umlinganiselo wesicwangciso awuvezwanga ngeSQL. Jonga iNeon console yogcino olukhoyo.
admin_ops_db_note_size_from_pg: Ubungakanani beDatabase buvela kwiPostgreSQL pg_database_size (ubungakanani obusengqiqweni kweli sebe leNeon).
admin_ops_db_note_quota_via_neon: Isicwangciso seNeon sokugcina isabelo asifumaneki ngeSQL. Ukusetyenziswa vs kufumaneke kufuna iNeon console okanye iNeon API.
admin_ops_db_note_live_counts: Ubalo lwetheyibhile luphila COUNT(*) kwi core tables, hayi pg_stat uqikelelo.
admin_ops_db_note_connection_failed: Uqhagamshelo uphando aluphumelelanga. Jonga i-DATABASE_URL kunye ne-Neon branch status.
no_owners_yet: Akukho banini okwangoku. Yenza enye ukubavumela ukuba bafikelele ezibhedlele.
no_user_groups_yet: Akukho maqela abasebenzisi okwangoku. Yenza enye ukuba yabele abasebenzi.
no_user_groups_create: Akukho maqela abasebenzisi. Yenza enye ngasentla.
no_branches_yet: Akukho masebe okwangoku. Yongeza isebe lesi sibhedlele.
no_user_groups: Akukho maqela abasebenzisi akhoyo kwesi sibhedlele.
user_groups_optional_hint: Khetha iqela elinye okanye ngaphezulu labasebenzisi (uyazikhethela).
store_central_help: Ubuncinane kwisebe ngalinye. I-GRN ithumela iimpahla kule venkile. Ukuba sele unevenkile ephakathi kweli sebe, yicime apho phambi kokuba uyenze apha.
item_master_barcode_scan_hint: Izikena ze-USB zihlala zichwetheza kwindawo ekugxilwe kuyo. Ukuskena kwekhamera kunokongezwa kamva.
item_master_batch_required_help: Xa yenziwe yasebenza, irisithi yempahla mayibandakanye inombolo yebhetshi, umhla wokuphelelwa, kunye nexabiso lokuthenga le nto (eqhelekileyo kwikhemesti).
item_master_unit_conversions_default_toa: Khetha iyunithi yomba kuqala, emva koko usebenzise Miyo ukuze utshatise iinguqulelo ezizibandakanyayo.
Akukho yunithi yokuguqulwa isebenzisa le yunithi yento ekuthengeni okanye ekukhutshweni.
item_master_unit_conversions_default_req: Khetha ukungagqibeki phakathi kweyunithi yoguqulelo oluqukiweyo.
item_master_category_hint: Kuphela kuNikezelo ngokuBanzi, uBonelelo lweKhemesti, okanye uBonelelo lwezoNyango (ukusuka kwiCandelo loMphathi).
item_master_pharmacy_generic_required: Khetha ikhemesti yamayeza awenziwe afana nalawo enziwe afana nalawo awenziwe ngabenzi bezinto zeZibonelelo zeKhemesti.
no_pharmacy_generics_create: Akukho generics ekhemesti. Yenza enye ngasentla.
unit_master_empty: Akukho ziyunithi okwangoku. Yenza enye ngasentla.
no_item_unit_profiles: Akukho nguqulelo okwangoku. Yenza enye ngasentla.
nursing_case_sheet_save_failed: Ayiphumelelanga ukugcina iphepha letyala kwizihlomelo zesigulana.
nursing_case_sheet_choose_visit: Khetha undwendwelo usebenzisa iqhosha elithi 'Khetha uNdwendwelo' ngasentla ukujonga iphepha letyala.
observation_emr_choose_visit: Khetha undwendwelo usebenzisa iqhosha elithi 'Khetha uNdwendwelo' ngasentla ukujonga idatha yoqwalaselo.
clinical_visit_signed_banner: Olu tyelelo lugcinwe njengoko lusayiniwe. Ukuqwalaselwa kunye nokuhlelwa kweCPOE kuvaliwe de ukhethe olunye utyelelo.
observation_save_as_signed_confirm: Gcina olu tyelelo njengoko lutyikityiwe? Oku akunakwenziwa kwakhona. Uqwalaselo kunye nokuhlelwa kweCPOE kuya kucinywa kolu tyelelo; i-nursing workbench ihlala ikhona.
observation_emr_casesheet_stub: Isicwangciso sokuKhathalela asifumaneki kwesi sakhiwo. Sebenzisa isicwangciso se-EMR somongikazi xa silungile.
observation_emr_plan_of_care_empty: Akukho mangenelo esicwangciso sokhathalelo kolu tyelelo.
observation_emr_progress_note_stub: Amanqaku enkqubela phambili awafumaneki kolu lwakhiwo. Sebenzisa amanqaku enkqubela phambili yomongikazi EMR xa sele ilungile.
observation_emr_progress_note_empty: Akukho manqaku enkqubela phambili kolu tyelelo.
observation_emr_progress_note_not_found: Elo nqaku lenkqubela phambili alizange lifunyanwe.
consultation_cpoe_prescription_note_plac: Bhala imiyalelo kagqirha, amayeza, ithamo, kunye neengcebiso zesigulana...
consultation_cpoe_prescription_empty: Akukho manqaku amiselweyo kolu tyelelo okwangoku.
observation_emr_order_line_locked_op_bil: Lo mgca ukwityala le-OP elivaliweyo kwaye awukwazi ukuhlelwa okanye ungasebenzi.
observation_emr_order_line_inactivate_hi: Lo mgca we-odolo uya kumakishwa njengongasebenziyo kwaye ukhutshelwe ngaphandle kwi-OP billing.
observation_emr_form_entry_inactivate_hi: Chwetheza kwakhona inkcazo yongeno engezantsi ukuze lungasebenzi olungeno.
delete_owner_confirm_suffix: ? Oku kuya kususa i-akhawunti yabo kwaye abasayi kuphinda bakwazi ukungena.
prefix_configuration_format_help: Iziqwenga zidityanisiwe ukuze kwakhiwe ikhowudi nganye. Yongeza umbhalo ongatshintshiyo, iindawo zedatha, kunye nenombolo esebenzayo.
prefix_configuration_format_empty: Yongeza ubuncinane iqhekeza elinye kwifomathi yekhowudi.
prefix_configuration_format_load_failed: Ifomati egciniweyo ayikwazanga kulayishwa; ukuqala kuyilo olungagqibekanga.
prefix_configuration_page_subtitle: Seta ukuba zakhiwe njani iikhowudi zesigulana, iinombolo zotyelelo, kunye neenombolo zeodolo yenkonzo. Injongo nganye isebenzisa iqhosha lenkqubo esisigxina; utshintsha kuphela inkcazo kunye nefomathi.
prefix_configuration_purpose_patient_hel: Isetyenziswa xa kubhaliswa izigulane ezitsha. Uhlobo londwendwelo alufumaneki kule khowudi.
prefix_configuration_purpose_visit_help: Isetyenziselwa utyelelo lwesigulana ngasinye; iquka isebe kunye nohlobo lotyelelo xa loo mimandla ikwifomathi.
prefix_configuration_purpose_order_help: Isetyenziswe xa kusenziwa imiyalelo yenkonzo. Ifomathi ehlala ikho ihambelana neYY/ndwendwela/NNN. Layita “Ulandelelwano olwahlukileyo ngotyelelo ngalunye” ukuze amanani e-odolo abale 001, 002… ngotyelelo lwesigulana ngasinye (kuyacetyiswa). Ukuba icinyiwe, ulandelelwano kwabelwana ngalo kuzo zonke ii-odolo ezisebenzisa ezinye izicwangciso zomda ezifanayo.
prefix_configuration_purpose_pr_help: Isetyenziswe xa udala iirekhwizishini zokuthenga (PR). Lungisa oku phambi kokuba abasebenzi benze iiPRs.
prefix_configuration_purpose_po_help: Isetyenziswe xa udala imiyalelo yokuthenga (PO). Lungisa oku phambi kokuba abasebenzi benze ii-PO.
prefix_configuration_purpose_di_help: Isetyenziswa xa kusenziwa i-indents yesebe. Lungiselela oku phambi kokuba abasebenzi benze i-idents.
prefix_configuration_purpose_di_issue_he: Isetyenziswa xa kusenziwa imiba yesebe ukusuka kumbindi ukuya kwiivenkile ezicelayo.
prefix_configuration_purpose_dc_help: Isetyenziswa xa kungeniswa amaxwebhu osetyenziso lwesebe ukuze amkelwe.
prefix_configuration_purpose_med_order_b: Isetyenziswe xa ugcina imiyalelo yeyeza yangaphakathi. Yonke imigca kwindawo enye yonga yabela le nombolo yebhetshi. Ukungagqibeki kusebenzisa unyaka-mali, isibhedlele, kunye nolandelelwano oluqhubayo.
prefix_configuration_counter_scope_help: Khetha ukuba yeyiphi imilinganiselo eyahlula inani elisebenzayo. Ifomati yokubonisa engentla yahlukile; oku kuchaphazela kuphela ulandelelwano oluzimeleyo olufumanayo.
inv_grn_api_hint: Yenza GRNs nge POST nge poId, storeId (central), receivedDate, kunye nemigca. Umgca ngamnye: i-poLineId, ithengelwe iQty (ngaphandle kwamahhala), i-batchNo, i-expiryDate, i-pursePrice (ifuneka xa into inokulandelela ibhetshi). Iibhetshi ziqhelekile (item_batch); isitokhwe ngokwevenkile nganye kunye nebhetshi (inv_stock).
inv_approval_config_intro: Qwalasela amanqanaba okwamkelwa kunye nababelwe ivenkile kunye nohlobo loxwebhu olukhethayo ngasentla.
inv_stock_search_modal_hint: Iziphumo zokukhangela zibandakanya kwi-esandleni kwivenkile ekhethiweyo (ukusuka) kuphela (iyunithi yokukhupha xa ikhona).
inv_receipt_from_store_view_issue_hint: Imboniselo ivula le risithi kwiphepha layo; Ubuyela umva apha (hayi kumbandela weSebe).
inv_stock_lot_hint: Imiqolo ithi `inv_stock` kudityaniswe `intwana_ibhetshi`, icwangciswe ngokuphelelwa lixesha (FEFO).
inv_user_groups_search_placeholder: Hluza amaqela abasebenzisi ngamagama okanye id...
inv_user_groups_no_filter_match: Akukho maqela abasebenzisi ahambelana nesi sihluzo.
inv_pr_approve_qty_hint: Faka umyinge ovunyiweyo ngomgca ngamnye ukuba uyahluka koko uceliweyo. I-PR qty elindileyo ixabisa imigca ehambelanayo kule venkile icelayo (ilindile, ithunyelwe emva, okanye ivunyiwe), kubandakanywa nesi sicelo.
cpoe_order_pending_empty: Akukho zinto okwangoku. Cofa + ukongeza into, emva koko Gcina iodolo.
inv_po_new_lines_need_pr_hint: Khetha isicelo sokuthenga esivunyiweyo ngasentla. Itheyibhile iya kulayisha apha ngomgca ngamnye: into, iyunithi (Ukuguqulwa kwe-Item Unit Master), ubuninzi obuseleyo, ubungakanani be-odolo, kunye nexabiso leyunithi.
inv_po_manual_unit_prereq: Khetha into kuqala, emva koko ukhethe iyunithi (uguqulelo) kuluhlu lwento yeYunithi eyiNtloko yoluhlu.
inv_po_manual_unit_none_configured: Le nto ayinakuguqulwa kweyunithi esebenzayo. Ziqwalasele phantsi koLungiso lweZintlu → Umphathi wento.
inv_po_new_po_pr_cps_only: Khetha ivenkile yokuthenga ephakathi kwibar ephezulu. Izicelo ezivunyiweyo zomyalelo omtsha wokuthenga zidweliswe kuphela xa loo venkile ikhethiweyo-ithunyelwa ekuthengeni okuphakathi, kungekhona kwezinye izitolo ezifana nekhemesti engeyiyo iCPS emiselweyo.
inv_po_cps_not_configured_pr: Qwalasela ivenkile yokuthenga ephakathi phantsi koLungiso lwe-Inventory → Ubume bempahla yesibhedlele phambi kokudala iiodolo zokuthenga ezivela kwiirikhwizishini.
inv_po_close_line_confirm: Vala lo mgca we-PO kwaye umaka i-qty eseleyo njengevaliweyo?
inv_pr_close_line_confirm: Vala lo mgca wePR ushiyekileyo qty (seta open-for-PO ukuya ku-0)?
inv_grn_receiving_store_none_central: Akukho venkile esembindini elungiselelwe lesebe lomyalelo wokuthenga. Irisithi yeempahla mayiposwe kwivenkile ephakathi yesebe. Kuseto lwe-Inventory, phawula ngqo ivenkile enye kwisebe ngalinye njengendawo esembindini (kusembindini wevenkile), uze uzame kwakhona.
inv_grn_select_po_for_store_hint: Khetha iodolo yokuthenga ukuze ubone ivenkile eyamkelayo.
inv_grn_batch_fields_hint: Inombolo yebhetshi, ukuphela kwexesha, kunye nexabiso lokuthenga liyafuneka kwizinto ezilandelelweyo.
inv_transfer_pick_batch_hint: Khetha okuninzi kwivenkile yomthombo, okanye ulayishe amaqashiso emva kokukhetha iivenkile.
inv_hub_subtitle: Ukuthengwa, isitokhwe, kunye neentshukumo zesi sibhedlele.
inv_hub_card_po: Yenza kwaye uvume ii-odolo zokuthenga, thumela kumthengisi.
inv_hub_card_grn: Rekhoda irisithi yempahla ngokuchasene nemiyalelo yokuthenga.
inv_store_central_purchasing_readonly: Ukuthenga okuphakathi kwabelwa phantsi kolungiselelo lwe-inventri yeSibhedlele.
inv_setup_central_purchasing_hint: I-PR, i-PO, kunye ne-GRN yeempahla ezithengiweyo zisebenzisa le venkile. Isitora esikhethiweyo siphawulwe njengokuthengwa kweCentral; engaphambili ibuyela kuQhoqo.
inv_pr_trace_hint: Xa umgca uphelele kwii-odolo zokuthenga, ubungakanani obuvulekileyo ngu-0 apha; umzila odola, ufunyenwe, kwaye usaza-ukufumana kwi-PO kunye nezikrini ze-GRN.
inv_pr_trace_po_mismatch: Iiodolo zokuthenga zikhona kule PR kodwa uluhlu alukwazanga kulayishwa. Zama ukuvuselela iphepha.
inv_pr_list_scope_hint: Ibar ephezulu ibeka uluhlu lwakho lwempahla / ucela (ukusuka) kwivenkile. Uluhlu lubonisa iirikhwizishini eziphakanyiswe yiloo venkile. Khetha Zonke iivenkile ukuze ubone iirikhwizishini kwivenkile nganye ecelayo, okanye sebenzisa isihluzo sekholamu yevenkile ukuze ucuthe ngokusuka kwivenkile.
inv_stock_list_scope_hint: Isitokhwe sinqunyelwe kwivenkile kwibar ephezulu. Khetha Zonke iivenkile ukuze ubone zonke iivenkile esibhedlele.
inv_di_list_scope_hint: Uluhlu lukhawulelwe kwiindenti eziphakanyiswe yivenkile kwibar ephezulu. Khetha Zonke iivenkile ukuze ubone zonke ii-indents zesebe.
inv_flow_procurement_chain: Yenza isicelo sokuthenga kwivenkile ecelayo (ibha ephezulu) → emva kokuvunywa, yenza umyalelo wokuthenga kwaye uthumele i-GRN kwivenkile eyamkelayo → kuluhlu lwe-GRN, sebenzisa i-Transfer ukuhambisa isitokhwe esifunyenweyo kwivenkile evule i-requisition (xa i-PR idibaniswe ne-PO).
inv_flow_pr_context: Ukusuka kwivenkile kuvela kwibar ephezulu. Khetha i Gcina kule mfuno.
inv_flow_po_context: Ii-PO zevenkile ekhethiweyo (ibha ephezulu) ilandela iirikhwizishini zokuthenga ezivunyiweyo okanye ukungena ngesandla; vuma uze uthumele kumthengisi phambi kokufunyanwa kwempahla.
inv_flow_grn_context: Iirisithi zokuthumela kwivenkile yokufumana (ibha ephezulu). Xa i-PO idibaniswe ne-requisition, sebenzisa i-Transfer ukuthumela isitokhwe kwivenkile yokucela emva kokuthumela i-GRN.
inv_po_list_select_store_hint: Khetha ivenkile kwibar ephezulu ukugxila kolu luhlu, okanye sebenzisa Zonke iiodolo zokuthenga esibhedlele xa kungekho venkile ikhethiweyo.
inv_page_department_issue_subtitle: Ivenkile ephakathi (ibha ephezulu = Ukusuka kwivenkile) iphakamisa imiba kwiivenkile ezicelayo: mhlawumbi ukusuka kwisebe elivunyiweyo elilindele ukuzaliseka, okanye ngesandla ngaphandle kwe-ident.

home_seo_title: Menzies Medora | Utyando oluzolileyo lwesibhedlele kwiqela ngalinye
home_seo_description: I-Medora yi-EMR yezibhedlele ezininzi zokubhalisa, ukutyelela, umsebenzi wekliniki, i-inventory, kunye nolawulo. I-Soft Wash console enye yabanini, abasebenzi, kunye nemigangatho yokhathalelo.
home_hero_headline: Guqula iintsuku zesibhedlele zibe zizolile, zihambe ngokudibeneyo
home_hero_body: I-Medora: imisebenzi yokhathalelo lwezibhedlele ezininzi ngobhaliso, utyelelo, iibhentshi zokusebenza zeklinikhi, kunye noluhlu lwempahla kwikhonsoli enye yomqeshi.
home_how_lead: Ukuhamba okukodwa kokungena kunye nokhathalelo olubhukisiweyo. Yakhelwe ngamaxesha amaqela eneneni ahambisa izigulane.
home_how_step1_body: Thatha isazisi, aleji, kunye nembali kanye. Lonke utyelelo lwamva luphinda lusebenzise itshati efanayo.
home_how_step2_body: Yenza i-OP okanye utyelelo lwe-IP, unamathisele ukuqeshwa, kwaye ugcine umxholo wesebe ucacile kumgangatho.
home_how_step3_body: Izinto ezibalulekileyo zabongikazi, ukuxilongwa, ii-odolo zamayeza, kunye namaxwebhu ahlala ngexesha elifanayo lokutyelela.
home_how_step4_body: Imiba ye-inventri, ukukhutshwa kwee-bill handoffs, kunye namanyathelo okukhutshwa ahlala edibene nerekhodi yokutyelela.
home_modules_lead: Iipakethe zokukwazi zigubungela iidesika ekufuneka zihlale zihambelana: iofisi engaphambili, imigangatho yekliniki, iivenkile kunye nolawulo.
home_modules_registration_body: Inkosi enesigulane, ndwendwela indalo, idinga, kunye nokungena kolwazi lwesebe.
home_modules_clinical_body: Iimodyuli zobuhlengikazi kunye nokubonisana kunye nezinto ezibalulekileyo, ukuxilongwa, ii-odolo, kunye namanqaku e-EMR.
home_modules_inventory_body: Iivenkile, iibhetshi, i-PR/PO/GRN, ukusetyenziswa kwesebe, kunye nezilumkiso zesitokhwe.
home_modules_admin_body: Abasebenzi, amasebe, amaqela abasebenzisi, iinkosi, amaxwebhu, kunye nokusekwa kwesibhedlele.
home_model_heading: I-SaaS enye. Izibhedlele ezininzi. Iindima ezicacileyo.
home_model_lead: IMedora inezibhedlele ezininzi ngokoyilo. Iqonga lidala isibhedlele. Isibhedlele siqhuba ukhathalelo. Izigulane azize ziyifune i-ofisi yakho yangasemva.
home_model_platform_body: Inkqubo ilawula abanini bembewu, izibhedlele, kunye noonogada zonke izabelo zabaqeshi.
home_model_hospital_body: Abanini kunye nabaphathi baqulunqa amasebe, iivenkile, ukufikelela kwabasebenzi, kunye neenkosi.
home_model_staff_body: Abongikazi, oogqirha, kunye namaqela evenkile asebenza kwiimodyuli eziqaphela indima emgangathweni.
home_model_patients_body: Iitshathi, utyelelo, namaxwebhu ahlala esibhedlele; abasebenzi basebenza kwi-console.
home_surfaces_nursing_body: IiVitals, i-allergies, amanqaku omongikazi, kunye nemisebenzi esecaleni kwebhedi ngaphandle kokushiya utyelelo.
home_surfaces_consult_body: Uxilongo, imiyalelo yamayeza, kunye namaxwebhu eklinikhi kwidesika kagqirha.
home_surfaces_inventory_body: Fumana, ukhuphe, udlulise, kwaye uphicothe isitokhwe kunye nebhetshi kunye nolwazi lokuphelelwa yisikhathi.
home_surfaces_admin_body: Abasebenzi, amasebe, amaqela ofikelelo, iinkosi zamaxwebhu, kunye noqwalaselo.
home_integrated_heading: Gcina idesika nganye kumda wexesha elinye
home_integrated_lead: Ukuqeshwa, amayeza, amaxwebhu, kunye neentshukumo zesitokhwe zabelana ngotyelelo ukuze umgangatho uhlale ulungelelene.
home_integrated_f5: Izilumkiso zestokhwe kunye neengxelo zokuphelelwa lixesha
home_cta_body: Sayina ungene kwikhonsoli yeMedora, khetha isibhedlele, kwaye uqale kwiimodyuli esele zisetyenziswa liqela lakho.
home_footer_tagline: Imisebenzi yesibhedlele yokubhalisa, ukhathalelo lweklinikhi, uluhlu lwempahla, kunye nolawulo.
home_scene_aria: Umfanekiso weWash ethambileyo yesibhedlele esisecaleni kwemithi ekwiyadi ezolileyo
pricing_seo_title: Menzies Medora amaxabiso | Cloud kunye ne-On-isiseko
pricing_seo_description: Isibhedlele saseMedora ixabiso le-EMR: Ifu ukusuka kwi-$ 99 / mo (uMqalisi ukuya kwi-Platform). Kwisiseko sisebenzisa amanqanaba afanayo kwixabiso lelifu + $150/mo yokufakela kwisiseko sakho. Ubhaliso, iklinikhi, uluhlu lwempahla, kunye nolawulo.
pricing_lead: Cloud SaaS okanye kwisiseko kwisiseko sakho. Umqali ofanayo, iShishini, isikali, kunye namanqanaba eQonga. Ubungakanani bezibhedlele kunye neemodyuli, hayi ixhala lemitha yotyelelo ngalunye.
pricing_lead_cloud: I-Cloud ibanjwe i-Soft Wash Medora: i-SaaS ye-multi-hospital, uhlaziyo olulawulwayo, kunye nezibonelelo ekwabelwana ngazo kuyo yonke indawo oyisebenzisayo.
pricing_lead_onprem: Kwindawo ekumgangatho ofanayo kumgangatho wemveliso ofanayo, ofakwe kwaye umiselwe kwiiseva zakho, ugcino lwedatha, kunye nenethiwekhi. Iziseko zophuhliso nguwe. Uluhlu lwenyanga luyi-Cloud + $ {premium} yolo xanduva.
pricing_lead_mmk: Ukubonisa i-MMK kwi-1 USD = {rate} MMK yokuthelekisa indawo.

pricing_who_lead: Iqonga, isibhedlele, abasebenzi, kunye nezigulana ngamnye ufumana indlela ecacileyo. Khetha ilifu okanye kwisiseko, emva koko inqanaba elifanayo elihambelana nokuba zingaphi izibhedlele kunye neemodyuli oziqhubayo.
pricing_who_platform_body: Abasebenzi abatyala izibhedlele ezininzi kwaye bafuna ileyibhile emhlophe kunye ne-SSO. Khetha iQonga kwiLifu okanye kwiNdawo.
pricing_who_hospital_body: Abanini kunye nabaphathi baqwalasela amasebe, iivenkile, ukufikelela kwabasebenzi, kunye neenkosi. Ishishini okanye isikali silingana uninzi lwamaqela amaziko amaninzi.
pricing_who_staff_body: Abongikazi, oogqirha, kunye namaqela evenkile kwiimodyuli zokuqonda indima. Isikali semida yesitulo kunye nesicwangciso; izigulane azize ziyibone iofisi yangasemva.
pricing_who_patients_body: Iitshathi, utyelelo, kunye namaxwebhu ahlala esibhedlele. Abasebenzi basebenza kwi-console kulo lonke ubhaliso ngokuvala.
pricing_faq_q1: Ngaba amaxabiso ngotyelelo ngalunye okanye ngesitulo sabasebenzi ngasinye?
pricing_faq_a1: Amanqanaba apapashiweyo ngokweqela ngalinye lesibhedlele elineekepusi zezihlalo. I-Cloud kunye ne-On-premise share Starter, Business, Scale, kunye nePlatform. Uluhlu lwenyanga olukwindawo yi-Cloud + $150. Akukho nanye imowudi esebenzisa imitha yotyelelo ngalunye olujikeleza ngeentsuku ezixakekileyo.
pricing_faq_a2: Ukuvalwa kweentlawulo zonyaka kunyaka oqikelelwayo we-Soft Wash Medora. Isibhedlele se-Loomline-style ye-SaaS ihlala ithoba izicwangciso zonyaka malunga ne-15 ukuya kwi-20%. I-Medora isebenzisa i-20% yesaphulelo kuluhlu lwenyanga xa uhlawula ngonyaka, kuzo zombini i-Cloud kunye ne-On-premise (emva kwe-+$150 yeprimiyamu ye-On-premise).
pricing_faq_q3: Ngaba i-inventri kunye neemodyuli zeklinikhi zibandakanyiwe?
pricing_faq_a3: Umqali ubandakanya ubhaliso olungundoqo, ukutyelela, kunye neebhentshi zokusebenza zeklinikhi kunye ne-inventory esisiseko. Ishishini nangaphezulu uvule uluhlu olupheleleyo lokuhamba komsebenzi, ii-odolo zamayeza ezinxulumene nesitokhwe, kunye nolawulo olutyebileyo. Buza xa ufuna izongezo ezilawulwayo.
pricing_faq_a4: Sebenzisa imarike yokuguqula ngaphezulu kwezicwangciso. Ihlabathi libonisa i-USD kuphela. IMyanmar ibonisa i-MMK kwi-1 USD = 5000 MMK (kunye ne-USD njengomgca wesibini). Ixesha lokuhlawula kunye nemo yenkonzo yahlukile kwimarike.
pricing_faq_a5: I-Cloud ibanjwe i-Soft Wash Medora: i-SaaS yezibhedlele ezininzi, uhlaziyo olulawulwayo, kunye nokuqalisa ngokukhawuleza. Kwindawo kusetyenziswa amanqanaba afanayo, afakwe kwisiseko sakho xa ufuna ulawulo okanye ukuhlala. I-Infra yeyakho; uluhlu lwenyanga yi Cloud + $ 150 yolo xanduva.
